scope: Source-backed accuracy/completeness and general reference clarity; no question/key/fact-index mutations

changes.old: Replenish partner zoos and universities so each is available exactly once (skip any that all players already have).
changes.new: **Restock one tile of each partner-zoo continent and each university kind**, except kinds **already owned by every player**; do not add duplicate available tiles.

changes.old: If you perform this action with strength **5 or more**, you may first increase your reputation by 1 — at the very beginning of the action, so your reputation range is already higher.
changes.new: At strength **5 or more**, you may **optionally gain 1 reputation first**, at the very beginning of the action, so the increased range applies to the animals you then play.

changes.old: Check the new special enclosure's terrain adjacency and available capacity.
changes.new: **The new special enclosure must meet each moved animal’s water/rock adjacency requirements and have enough free capacity.**

changes.old: (take any printed bonus; advance your Reputation counter if the university shows it).
changes.new: and take its covered-space bonus immediately. **Also gain the reputation printed on the university tile immediately.**

changes.old: The Base Conservation Projects below the board are never moved, even when fully supported, and no new base projects are added during the game.
changes.new: **The Base Conservation Projects below the board never move and are never replenished**, even when fully supported.

changes.old: Taking a token off your zoo map activates its bonus — gained immediately, and for some bonuses again in each break; you choose whether to take it before or after the project reward.
changes.new: Taking a token off your zoo map activates its bonus. **Gain it immediately**, before or after the project reward at your choice. **If marked as recurring income, gain that same bonus again in every break.**

changes.old: During each break the folder 1 and 2 cards are discarded before refilling.
changes.new: **During the break, at step 4 before income**, discard folder 1 and 2 cards, compact the remaining cards and refill the display.

changes.old: For an effect written "X : Y," a condition without a number (or with "per") pays once per fulfillment.
changes.new: For an effect written "X : Y," **X on the left is the condition and Y on the right is the reward**. A condition without a number (or with "per") pays once per fulfillment.

changes.old: | 208 Science Library | I: 1 appeal per research icon. R: each research icon played in **any** zoo gives you 2 money.
changes.new: | 208 Science Library | I: 1 appeal per research icon. R: whenever any player plays a research icon, **you, the Science Library owner, gain 2 money**.

changes.old: Each Build action may add **one extra copy** of a building you built, without additional strength.
changes.new: Each Build action may add **one extra copy of a building built in that same Build action**, without additional strength.

changes.old: **Map 8, Hollywood Hills:** covering each H reveals deck cards until a Sponsor appears; keep it and discard the others. H is not a placement bonus (so does not trigger Archaeologist). After covering all three, every Sponsor's level is one lower.
changes.new: **Map 8, Hollywood Hills:** cover H spaces by placing buildings under the ordinary placement rules. When an H is covered, reveal deck cards until a Sponsor appears; keep it and discard the others. H is not a placement bonus (so does not trigger Archaeologist). After covering all three, every Sponsor's level is one lower. Its bonus partner zoos still require Association II for the third/fourth partner; bonus buildings still require Build II to cover upgrade-marked spaces.

additions.Pack: - **Pack 1** (illustrated Lion): when played, gain one additional appeal per predator icon in **your own zoo**, including this animal’s own predator icon. This counts icons already present when played, rather than rewarding future predators. Keep this ability-earned appeal if the animal is later released.
additions.project_tables:
**Other illustrated project rewards** (left / middle / right levels; choose any fulfilled, unoccupied level under the normal support rules):

| Project in the main-rule examples | Requirement and reward |
|---|---|
| Reptiles | 5 / 4 / 2 reptile icons give 5 / 4 / 2 conservation. |
| Large Animals | 4 / 3 / 2 large animals give 4 / 3 / 2 conservation. Large means printed standard-enclosure requirement 4–5. |
| Aquatic | The visible outer levels require 5 / 2 water icons for 4 / 2 conservation. The middle reward is 3 conservation; use the card’s printed middle requirement, which is obscured in the supplied illustration. |
| Serengeti National Park | Release one Africa animal with printed standard size 4+ / 3 / 2− for 5 / 4 / 3 conservation. Bringing the project into play also grants 1 reputation; supporting it later does not grant that play bonus. |
| Reptile Breeding Program | Have a reptile and a partner zoo from that reptile’s continent; the same condition applies to all three spaces. Their rewards are **2 conservation + 2 reputation / 1 conservation + 2 reputation / 2 conservation**. Choose any available space. |
